chapterInfo.content:
36
Yudahene Yehoahas
1 # 2 Ah 23.30 Na asase no sofoɔ no faa Yosia ba Yehoahas sii no hene n’agya ananmu Yerusalem. 2Yehoahas dii mfeɛ aduonu mmiɛnsa na ɔbɛdii hene, na ɔdii hene abosome mmiɛnsa wɔ Yerusalem. 3Na Misraimhene no tuu no adeɛ so Yerusalem, na ɔgyee asase no apeatoɔ dwetɛ dwetikɛseɛ ɔha ne sika dwetikɛseɛ.
Yudahene Yehoiakim
4Na Misraimhene no de ne nua Eliakim sii Yuda ne Yerusalem so hene, na ɔdanee ne din yɛɛ no Yehoiakim; na ne nua Yehoahas deɛ, Neko faa no kɔɔ Misraim. 5Yehoiakim dii mfeɛ aduonu nnum na ɔbɛdii hene, na ɔdii hene mfeɛ dubaako wɔ Yerusalem. Na ɔyɛɛ AWURADE ne Nyankopɔn ani so bɔne.
6 # Yer 22.18 Ɔno so na Babelhene Nebukadnessar foro baeɛ, na ɔde kɔbere mfrafraeɛ mpokyerɛ guu no, sɛ ɔde no rekɔ Babel. 7#Esra 1.7 Na AWURADE fie nnoɔma no bi nso Nebukadnessar de kɔɔ Babel kɔsiee n’ahemfie wɔ Babel. 8Na Yehoiakim ho nsɛm nkaeɛ ne n’akyiwadeɛ a ɔyɛeɛ, ne deɛ wɔhunuu no ne ho no, hwɛ, wɔatwerɛ no Israel ne Yuda Ahemfo Nwoma no mu. Na ne ba Yehoiakyin bɛdii n’adeɛ.
Yudahene Yehoiakyin
9Yehoiakyin dii mfeɛ nwɔtwe na ɔbɛdii hene, na ɔdii hene abosome mmiɛnsa ne dadu wɔ Yerusalem. Na ɔyɛɛ AWURADE ani so bɔne. 10#Yer 22.24-30 Na afe no duruiɛ no, Ɔhene Nebukadnessar soma maa wɔbɛfaa no ne AWURADE fie afɛfɛdeɛ nso kɔɔ Babel, na ɔde ne nua Sedekia sii Yuda ne Yerusalem so hene.
Yudahene Sedekia
11 # Yer 52.1-27 Sedekia dii mfeɛ aduonu baako na ɔbɛdii hene, na ɔdii hene mfeɛ dubaako Yerusalem. 12Na ɔyɛɛ AWURADE ne Nyankopɔn ani so bɔne. Wammrɛ ne ho ase Odiyifoɔ Yeremia a na ɔkasa AWURADE ano no anim. 13Afei nso ɔtee Ɔhene Nebukadnessar a ɔmaa no kaa Nyankopɔn ntam no anim atua. Na ɔsenee ne kɔn na ɔpirim n’akoma sɛ ɔrensane mma AWURADE Israel Nyankopɔn nkyɛn. 14#Deut 18.9 Nso asɔfoɔ no mu mpanimfoɔ nyinaa ne ɔman no maa wɔn mmarato dɔɔso pii sɛ wiase amanaman akyiwadeɛ nyinaa, na wɔguu AWURADE fie a wayɛ no kronkron Yerusalem no ho fi.
15Na AWURADE wɔn agyanom Nyankopɔn no somaa n’abɔfoɔ baa wɔn nkyɛn, ɔtuaa nhema somaa wɔn, ɛfiri sɛ ne yam hyehyee no maa ne man ne ne tenabea no. 16#Luk 20.10-12; Aso 7.52 Nanso wɔdii Nyankopɔn abɔfoɔ no ho fɛw, na wɔbuu ne nsɛm no animtia, na wɔsereseree n’adiyifoɔ no de kɔsii sɛ AWURADE abufuhyeɛ no sɔre tiaa ne man no a wɔannya ano aduro.
Babel tukorɔ
17Na ɔyii Kaldeafoɔ hene no baa wɔn so, na ɔde nkrantɛ bɛkunkumm wɔn mmeranteɛ, wɔ wɔn kronkronbea fie, na wanni aberanteɛ ne ababaa, akɔkoraa ne deɛ wafu dwono ho adɔna, ɔde wɔn nyinaa hyɛɛ wɔn nsa. 18Na Nyankopɔn fie nnoɔma no nyinaa, akɛseɛ ne nketewa, ne AWURADE fie akoradeɛ ne ɔhene no ne ne mmapɔmma akoradeɛ, ɔde ne nyinaa kɔɔ Babel. 19Na wɔhyee Nyankopɔn fie no, na wɔdwirii Yerusalem fasuo no, na emu aban afɛfɛ nyinaa, wɔde ogya hyee, na emu afɛfɛdeɛ nyinaa sɛee. 20Na nkaeɛ a wɔantotɔ afena ano no, ɔtuu wɔn kɔɔ Babel na wɔkɔyɛɛ ɔno ne ne mma nkoa kɔsii Persia ahennie no kyekyerɛ, 21#Lew 26.34; Yer 25.8-11 sɛ wɔmma AWURADE asɛm a ɔde Yeremia ano kaeɛ no mmra mu, sɛ ɛnkɔsi sɛ asase no ani bɛsɔ ne home mfeɛ no; amamfo nna nyinaa na ɛrehome akɔsi sɛ mfirinhyia aduɔson bɛwie duro.
Kores gya ɔman no kwan
22 # Esra 1.1-3 Na Persiahene Kores afe a ɛdi kan mu no, sɛ AWURADE asɛm a ɔde Yeremia ano kaeɛ no bɛba mu nti, AWURADE kanyann Persiahene Kores honhom, na ɔmaa wɔkɔpaee no n’ahennie nyinaa mu, na wɔtwerɛe nso sɛ: 23Sɛ Persiahene Kores seɛ nie: Asase so ahennie nyinaa na AWURADE, ɔsoro Nyankopɔn no de ahyɛ me nsa, na ɔno ara de ato me so sɛ mensi efie memma no Yerusalem a ɛwɔ Yuda. Mo mu biara a ɔwɔ ha a ɔbɛtumi no, AWURADE ne Nyankopɔn nni n’akyi, na ɔmforo nkɔ.

Na asase no sofoɔ no faa Yosia ba Yehoahas sii no hene n’agya ananmu Yerusalem. Yehoahas dii mfeɛ aduonu mmiɛnsa na ɔbɛdii hene, na ɔdii hene abosome mmiɛnsa wɔ Yerusalem. Na Misraimhene no tuu no adeɛ so Yerusalem, na ɔgyee asase no apeatoɔ dwetɛ dwetikɛseɛ ɔha ne sika dwetikɛseɛ.

Na Misraimhene no de ne nua Eliakim sii Yuda ne Yerusalem so hene, na ɔdanee ne din yɛɛ no Yehoiakim; na ne nua Yehoahas deɛ, Neko faa no kɔɔ Misraim. Yehoiakim dii mfeɛ aduonu nnum na ɔbɛdii hene, na ɔdii hene mfeɛ dubaako wɔ Yerusalem. Na ɔyɛɛ AWURADE ne Nyankopɔn ani so bɔne.

Nso asɔfoɔ no mu mpanimfoɔ nyinaa ne ɔman no maa wɔn mmarato dɔɔso pii sɛ wiase amanaman akyiwadeɛ nyinaa, na wɔguu AWURADE fie a wayɛ no kronkron Yerusalem no ho fi.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
